snippet.title: New Trailer Released! | The Hottest New Upcoming Strategy RPG! | Sit-Back Attack
snippet.description:
This is a flashy, build enabling, deep, fun time!
Join us on our journey to release Sit-Back Attack.
Coming THIS November!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092260/SitBack_Attack/

Conquer your free time with this Strategic Idle-RPG that grinds for you! Gathering unique loot, upgrading materials, and XP. Allowing you to jump straight into the fray by crafting equipment, leveling 60+ unique characters, taking on epic boss battles, and challenge an endless tower of difficulty!
